_comment: Codex CLI provider — requires the codex CLI (https://github.com/openai/codex). Uses 'codex exec' which reads the prompt from stdin. Cloud mode requires OPENAI_API_KEY; local mode uses --oss --local-provider to talk to LM Studio or Ollama.

providers._comment: Cloud mode — uses your OpenAI account. Set OPENAI_API_KEY in your environment.
providers.name: codex

providers._comment: Local mode — uses LM Studio as the backend. No API key needed.
providers.name: codex-lmstudio

providers._comment: Local mode — uses Ollama as the backend. No API key needed.
providers.name: codex-ollama
